name: Small, Circular, Covered Box, the Domed Cover with Decoration of a Butterfly
dimensions: including cover: H. 3.4 x Diam. 5 cm (1 5/16 x 1 15/16 in.)
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；probably 9th century；Off-white stoneware with pale celadon glaze over decoration applied in white slip, the decoration embellished with incising and with touches of iron-brown slip in localized areas.  Possibly from the Yaozhou kilns, near Tongchuan, Shaanxi province.
